entries.zh: 钦奉圣旨，遵行皇家敕令
entries.en: to execute the royal mandate; to reverently receive and carry out an imperial edict
to exceed; to surpass, to outdo

entries.zh: 胜尽，全然胜过；超出殆尽
entries.en: to exceed; to surpass utterly, to outdo completely
entries.notes: 音写栏第二读 sêng cō 与汉字'尽'不合，疑系'胜过'之别读，故降置信

entries.en: to exceed excessively; to go beyond due measure
entries.notes: 汉字栏作[疑:忝/泰]，语义依西语 exceder demasiado 与音写 tiām 定为'过度'

entries.en: to exceed, surpass; to go beyond

entries.zh: 报复过当，打过头；恨极痛打
entries.en: to exceed in vengeance; to strike beyond measure in revenge
entries.notes: 首字栏[疑:忝/泰]，语义依西语 exceder en la vengança 与音写 tiām pa（打）

entries.zh: 引导，导引；以身为范、为人表率
entries.en: to guide, to lead; a guide or model who leads by example

entries.zh: 首倡，倡始；可为表率以供效仿之人
entries.en: one who initiates or takes the lead; an exemplar to imitate
entries.notes: 音写栏混入西语残句（buenos sposos 等），仅据西语词头、汉字'倡'及音写 chiāng 定义；缩写 p̃ 读作 para

entries.zh: 譬论，设譬论说；用比方讲道理
譬谕（即譬喻），打比方晓谕
entries.en: example; simile, parable; to illustrate by comparison

entries.zh: 接譬，续举譬喻把话说明白；另举例说明
entries.en: to explain oneself with another example; an added comparison to make things clear
entries.notes: 音写首音节 van 与汉字'接'不合，疑原字为'换'；缩写 p̃a 读作 para

entries.zh: 唱随（夫唱妇随），妻子随顺丈夫，旧时视为可供效法的好榜样
entries.en: the wife following her husband's lead; a good example to imitate

entries.zh: 芬芳，香气；亦喻美好声名风范
entries.notes: 汉字'芬芳'与音写 hūn hong 确为芳香义，而西语词头作'exemplo bueno p̃ imitar'（好榜样），两栏不合，疑西栏误读
首字栏[疑:趟/範]，音写 fān 支持作'範'

entries.zh: 法则，法度；为后人立下的规矩先例
entries.en: rule, law; precedent, an example for those who come after
entries.notes: 西语'exemplo p̃ los uenidos'依赖缩写展开读作'exemplo para los venidos'（为后来者立例），与'法则'相合
